subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: For this provider-backed hot-reload change, is focused gateway lifecycle coverage sufficient, or must maintainers require redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login evidence before merge?
rationale: The remaining blocker is an evidence threshold rather than a mechanical defect, and the contributor cannot produce a real provider session from the current environment.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real QR-login setup records redacted evidence that adding account B leaves account A online after the reload.

options.title: Accept gateway regression proof
options.body: Explicitly waive provider-level proof and merge based on the focused lifecycle regressions plus normal CI once required checks complete.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real QR-login setup records redacted evidence that adding account B leaves account A online after the reload.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR context identifies this person as an early gateway discussion contact, though the available provenance is not enough to establish exclusive ownership.
